targets.title: Earnings management to avoid earnings decreases and losses.
targets.evidence_quote: We replicate Burgstahler and Dichev’s (1997) analysis for a global sample relative to a more recent period.
targets.outcome_quote: This study aimed to search for evidence of earnings management to avoid earnings decreases and losses across the World, replicating Burgstahler and Dichev’s (1997) study for a more recent and global sample, incorporating firms from different cultural and legal contexts as well as from different periods. We found persistent evidence of earnings management to avoid reporting losses, but we found no consistent evidence of earnings management to avoid earnings decreases.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The paper confirms loss avoidance but contrasts its failure to find earnings-decrease avoidance and component evidence with the original. No overall verdict overrides these comparisons.

reasoning: New global firm sample explicitly re-tests Burgstahler and Dichev (1997). Other cited papers supply background or proposed future analyses, not additional targets.
